messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, {04 1f 00}! I've got
the coolest furniture in
my room now!
{07 0d 00}It makes me wanna flail my
arms and sing a happy
little song, {04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, {04 1f 00}! Mul on nüüd
toas kõige lahedam
mööbel!
{07 0d 00}See paneb mind käsi
vehkima ja rõõmsat
laulukest laulma, {04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I don't know if it's because
I put new furniture around
my room or what, but...
{07 0a 00}I just feel like life is
all rainbows and flowers
lately, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma ei tea, kas see on sest,
et ma panin tuppa uut
mööblit, või millest, aga...
{07 0a 00}Mul on tunne, et elu on
viimasel ajal lust ja
lillepidu, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I've got TONS of new
furniture in my house!

{07 0d 00}It makes me so happy,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Mul on TONNIDE viisi uut
mööblit majas!

{07 0d 00}Ma olen nii õnnelik,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
